$comment: OpenCode counterpart of the ASK rules in hooks/rules.mjs. Claude Code and Codex run the hook itself; OpenCode cannot ask the user from a plugin, so the questions become native permission rules, merged into opencode.json by `claude-plugin-to-codex --target opencode`. Globs are approximate (a launcher such as npx or pnpm dlx is covered by the leading *): rules.mjs stays the reference, and the DENY rules are enforced exactly by the generated guard plugin. Order matters: OpenCode applies the last matching rule.
